name: Zacarias Monzon
headline: CTO at Hourlywork. Executive MBA
about:
Technology leader with experience leading and managing delivery of production ready, scalable and secured mobile and web applications to the marketplace. Lead the development and market introduction of HourlyWork and Simfinix. Both software applications were delivered on-time and on-budget. My experience on these applications included strategic planning around the product development, hiring and coaching, software architecture, development of the software development process, implementing software development tools, and working with end users to market test and iteratively enhance the products.
… more

experiences.description:
Led the successful launch of a mobile-based recruiting application aimed at connecting businesses with hourly job workers. Integrated
cutting-edge features including swiping, chat, email, video-based calling, texting, QR code technology, and search, while ensuring rigorous
testing for auto-scalability to support diverse workloads. Achieved the first product release within an 8-month development timeframe,
followed by the second version, which included online scheduling and location-based check-in/check-out, completed six months later.

▪Formulated SAAS architecture, instituted data governance strategies, and designed models for improved system performance.
▪ Selected a UI/UX design firm and collaborated with the team to create a design-led mobile application.
▪ Hired and onboarded software development and QA team to add value to the existing team with broad perspectives.
▪ Designed a microservices-based system architecture ensuring automatic scalability to accommodate user workloads.
▪ Implemented security features to protect user and customer data in compliance with set privacy regulations.
▪ Incorporated Stripe for SKU and payment management, streamlining transactions and enhancing financial efficiency.
▪ Developed a flexible pricing structure tailored to meet the dynamic requirements of the business.
▪ Created a bi-weekly sprint process that optimized software delivery and quality, including the development of KPIs that
measured software velocity.
▪ Interacted with customers to gather product feedback for ongoing software validation.
